## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behaviour. Link any related issue.

## Verification

- [ ] `npm run check`
- [ ] `npm test`

- [ ] Visible changes checked on desktop and phone, in light and dark modes

For map additions, identify the original file, batch, verified credits and release asset. For layout or viewer changes, include screenshots and mention portrait maps, keyboard navigation and loading/retry states checked.
